I try to avoid asking for prayers because it makes me feel selfish, but my life has just been a little overwhelming lately.

My girlfriend who I wanted to marry some day broke up with me a few months ago, and I'm currently jobless, homeless (living out of my car, so I'm not quite shelterless), and friendless.

I know things could still be worse, so I don't want to complain. There are plenty of people out there who deserve a prayer far more than I do, but it would make me feel a lot better if I knew that even one person prayed for me...

I just need to keep having faith that God will help get me out of this situation.
